summary: Houston, ColdFusion user group manager, web development since 1999, strong interest in programming languages (Java, Go, Lua, ColdFusion), experience with MongoDB and distributed systems, critical of outsourcing and off-shore development, views on tech industry ethics and censorship, married, has Cystic Fibrosis, interest in user group management and community building, active in tech conferences, skeptical of startup culture and VC-driven models, advocates for sustainable business practices over rapid growth, engaged in discussions about open source and software security.
